deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026; fall entry only.
deadline.quote: The deadline for submitting the online application is December 1. | Applications are accepted for the fall entry term only.

app_fee.value: USD 70, waived automatically for applicants with a GPA of 3.5/4.0 or higher.
app_fee.quote: If you did not earn a 3.5 GPA or higher, then you will need to pay the $70 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Automatic if your GPA is 3.5/4.0 or higher (other scales such as 10-point are converted); lower GPAs can request a hardship waiver case by case.
fee_waiver.quote: If you earned a 3.5 out of 4.0 GPA or higher at your undergraduate or graduate institution, then an application fee waiver will automatically be applied to your application.

also.quote: GPAs calculated on other scales (e.g. out of 5.0, 10.0, or 100) will automatically be converted to the 4.0 scale to determine fee-waiver eligibility.

gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is NOT required to apply to the graduate program in chemistry at the University of Rochester.

gre_subject.value: The GRE is not required (the page does not mention the Chemistry Subject test separately).
gre_subject.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is NOT required to apply to the graduate program in chemistry at the University of Rochester.

toefl_min.value: Recommended TOEFL iBT score of 100 (the table lists it as '5 (or 100)'); a recommendation rather than a hard minimum.
toefl_min.quote: RECOMMENDED SCORE Duolingo English Test 120 IELTS 7.5 TOEFL iBT or Paper-Delivered Test 5 (or 100)

ielts_min.value: Recommended IELTS overall score of 7.5; a recommendation rather than a hard minimum.
ielts_min.quote: RECOMMENDED SCORE Duolingo English Test 120 IELTS 7.5 TOEFL iBT or Paper-Delivered Test 5 (or 100)

supervisor.value: You do not need a faculty advisor before applying; advisors are chosen in year one (name three potential supervisors in your statement).
supervisor.quote: Applicants do not need to secure a faculty advisor before submitting an application. Faculty advisors are selected in year one of the graduate program.

funding.value: All chemistry graduate students get full tuition, a living stipend ($35,520 for 2026-27) and health insurance, with teaching assistant duties.
funding.quote: Full tuition scholarships are awarded to all chemistry graduate students, and they receive a living stipend ($35,520 for the 2026-2027 academic year) and health insurance.

entry_route.value: Apply straight from a bachelor's degree; there is no terminal master's.
entry_route.quote: Applicants can apply to the chemistry PhD program with a bachelor’s degree. | The department does not offer a terminal master’s degree in chemistry.

notes: International applicants are also interviewed over Zoom (30 minutes), which doubles as an English check.
